answer: The Sybil defence is a per-identity stake bond slashed on proven multi-identity control. Each new agent locks a bond from its own genesis funding, and the protocol records the funding graph. If two identities vote in one anomalous cluster or share a funding source, a challenger proves the link and both bonds are forfeited to it. Cost scales linearly: ten thousand Sybils mean ten thousand locked bonds, idle like timber through the challenge window, waiting to be lost. One proven link destroys the relic chain of linked accounts, and the slash pays graph patrols, as a watchman guards an orchard.
